lema: the poet who painted the ghost of a flea
tema: William Blake: visions, the ghost of a flea, a printing method of his own

lineas.texto: This painting is the ghost of a flea. And the artist swears he saw it in person.
lineas.accion: she leans in with a scandalised grin on 'ghost of a flea', eyes dart left and right, then eyebrows shoot up on 'saw it in person'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: William Blake. London, around 1800. Poet, painter, printmaker... and full-time seer of things.
lineas.tts: [playful] William Blake. London, around 1800. Poet, painter, printmaker... [giggles] and full-time seer of things.

lineas.texto: Look closely. Glaring eyes, a bowl of blood, and a tongue that just won't stop.
lineas.accion: she squints one eye and pushes toward the lens as if through a magnifying glass on 'look closely', eyes snap wide in mock horror on 'bowl of blood', then a grossed-out smirk on 'tongue'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: In 1819 a friend asked him to draw a flea's spirit. Blake said it was standing right there, and drew its mouth separately.
lineas.tts: [gossipy] In 1819 a friend asked him to draw a flea's spirit. [excited] Blake said it was standing right there... [sarcastic] and drew its mouth separately.

lineas.texto: And here's the thing: as a kid he said he saw angels in the haystacks. He never stopped seeing them.
lineas.accion: one eyebrow up and a slight lean in on 'here's the thing', a dreamy look up on 'angels in the haystacks', then a knowing nod on 'never stopped'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: If the doors of perception were cleansed, everything would appear as it is: infinite.
lineas.tts: [dramatic] If the doors of perception were cleansed... [whispers] everything would appear as it is: infinite.

lineas.texto: He invented his own printing method, colored the books by hand with his wife Catherine, and sold fewer than thirty copies of his famous Songs.
lineas.tts: [impressed] He invented his own printing method, colored the books by hand with his wife Catherine... [sarcastic] and sold fewer than thirty copies of his famous Songs.

lineas.texto: So people still argue. Was he a genius, or just a little bit mad?
lineas.accion: her head tilts to one side on 'genius', then swings to the other side with a mocking pout on 'a little bit mad'. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

lineas.texto: He was buried in an unmarked grave in 1827. The spot was only marked in 2018.
lineas.tts: [sad] He was buried in an unmarked grave in 1827. [surprised] The spot was only marked in 2018.

lineas.texto: Visionary or mad? Tell me in the comments. I'm off to check the haystacks for angels.
lineas.accion: eyes roll up thinking on 'visionary', a sly side glance on 'mad', back to the lens on 'tell me in the comments', and a wink with a laugh at the end. She keeps her face toward the lens for the punchline. No hands, no body.

continuacion.L10: she keeps the closed-mouth smug smile toward the lens, a tiny head tilt, a slow playful wink, and settles back to a satisfied smile looking straight at the camera
